title: Hermite affine integral recurrence
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number and let $\rho,s,x\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $\rho^2+s^2=1$. The standard Gaussian integral of the Hermite polynomial of degree $k+2$ evaluated at $\rho x+s y$ equals $\rho x$ times the corresponding integral for degree $k+1$, minus $(k+1)\rho^2$ times the corresponding integral for degree $k$.
